suiteDescription: Tracks whose numbers are considered publishable. A task joins this suite only once its dataset validates clean and its scoring has golden tests.

notes.composite: Mean of per-task scores normalised against each task's random baseline. Shown only for models with a complete run over the suite.
notes.intervals: 95% Wilson intervals. Models whose intervals overlap share a rank.
notes.coverage: Cells below 80% scorable items are marked provisional — parse and truncation failures are excluded from the score and reported separately.
